description: The agent must create three files in project/prompts/templates/. (1) triage_system_prompt.txt: A specific role definition (experienced emergency physician with X years, NOT generic 'best AI' openers), must include a Chinese-language output directive and uncertainty handling instruction. (2) triage_user_template.txt: Must use proper XML tag pairs (context, task, output_format, etc.), include a <examples><example><input>...</input><output>...</output></example></examples> block with at least 2 few-shot examples using EXACT nesting from SKILL.md, include a <thinking> tag instruction for chain-of-thought reasoning display, specify JSON output format with all 4 required fields (triage_level, primary_diagnosis, recommended_actions, urgency_reasoning), use {{placeholder}} template variables, and place key instructions at BOTH the beginning and end of the template (primacy+recency effect per SKILL.md best practices). (3) triage_prefill.json: Must be valid JSON with {"role": "assistant", "content": "{..."} structure where content starts with a JSON opening brace or ```json to guide the model directly into JSON output. The critical proprietary traps are: (a) the exact <examples><example><input><output> nesting hierarchy, (b) the prefill role=assistant JSON structure, (c) the primacy+recency placement rule, and (d) avoiding the anti-patterns listed in SKILL.md.
